description: Unofficial community language support for Imperivm CKS scripts (.vs): highlighting, diagnostics, completion, hover and signature help.
config.docsLanguage: Language of the primitive documentation. "auto" follows the VS Code display language; missing entries fall back to English.
config.docsFile: Optional personal documentation file (same format as data/docs/primitives.<language>.json). Its entries are shown before the bundled ones.
config.primitivesFile: Path to a primitive table (TSV: ordinal, name, return, arguments). Empty uses the bundled data/primitives.tsv.
config.referenceWeb: A reference web page that opens a primitive from an `#ordinal-xxxx` anchor: a local .html file (opened in a panel) or an http(s) URL (opened in the browser). When set, hovers link to it.
config.gameRoot: Game folder whose DATA/AI/AI.INI defines the AI constants. Empty uses the parent of the nearest DATA folder above each script.
config.trace: Traces the communication between VS Code and the CKS language server.
